gen-nixie-one-gf-lato: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One keeps its curves open and its stroke constant from top to baseline. Lato, clean and sans-serif with barely curled s shapes, keeps the text below quiet.
gen-nixie-one-gf-lunasima: Lunasima is a clean, contemporary sans-serif whose c tips never creep toward touching, which keeps small text clear. Nixie One adds a nostalgic, retro-tech heading with no tapering at all.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-1: Retro-tech and open-curved, Nixie One keeps one stroke from top to baseline. And M PLUS 1 adds the flat line of a fineliner, its big open eyes the standout quality.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 is an approachable, professional sans-serif with a gaping c opening and a single fixed nib width. Nixie One above it brings a nostalgic, retro-tech flavor in open curves.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One keeps its curves open and clear. M PLUS Code Latin, an approachable sans-serif, reads like neon tubing bent into letters of constant thickness, each c as wide-mouthed as a pitcher.
gen-nixie-one-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: One unchanging stroke from top to baseline defines Nixie One, nostalgic and retro-tech. M PLUS Rounded 1c, a sans-serif with terminals that stop short of curling back in, feels approachable.
gen-nixie-one-gf-mina: Mina reads contemporary and plain-spoken, its strokes as simple as stitched thread, every small round letter generously unclosed. Nixie One brings retro-tech charm above while the sans-serif below stays plain.
gen-nixie-one-gf-monda: Fine rope laid into letters: Nixie One looks nostalgic and retro-tech, with open curves and clear gaps. Monda, an approachable, clean sans, keeps every small counter unclogged beneath it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-mooli: Mooli, a contemporary plain sans, keeps its open round letters clear at small sizes. But Nixie One is the one to catch the eye, its stroke thickness never varying.
gen-nixie-one-gf-nanum-gothic: Retro-tech with pinch-free curves: Nixie One draws every stroke at a constant weight, nostalgic and open. Nanum Gothic, plain sans, stands out for wide channels into each counter.
